newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Plane crashes on eve of Moscow airshow, one dead.
newsitem.headline: Plane crashes on eve of Moscow airshow, one dead.

text.p: One person died when an aircraft crashed on Monday near the town of Zhukovsky outside Moscow during preparations for an international airshow due to open there on Tuesday, an Emergencies Ministry spokesman said.

"The only information we have is that one person died in a plane crash in Zhukovsky. The flight was part of preparations for the show," the spokesman told Reuters. President Boris Yeltsin is due to open the event on Tuesday.
